III. Read the passage and do the tasks below (1.4 points)

Hi, my name is Phong. Tet is coming soon, so my family is preparing many things for our favorite holiday. Tomorrow, we are going to decorate our house. My father is going to hang a new calendar on the wall, and I am going to help him clean the wooden furniture. My mother is very busy because she needs to cook special food like banh chung. She also buys sweet rice and fruits. My parents tell me that during Tet, children should follow good customs. We should behave well, use polite words, and help with easy housework. Moreover, we shouldn't break things, fight, or eat too many sweets. On the first day of Tet, we are going to a pagoda to make a wish for health and happiness. Then, adults will give lucky money in red envelopes to kids. I love Tet because it is a wonderful time for family gatherings.

Task 1: Decide whether the statements are True (T) or False (F)

32. Phong's father plans to hang a new calendar and Phong will help him clean the furniture.

33. According to Phong's parents, children should break things and fight during Tet.

34. Phong's family is going to visit a pagoda on the first day of Tet to make a wish.

Task 2: Answer the questions short & concisely

II. Rewrite the sentences so that it has the same meaning as the first one (1.0 point)

Question 41. It is a good idea for us to behave well at Tet.

→ We should

Question 42. I advise you not to break things or fight with others.

→ You shouldn't

Question 43. My grandfather plans to plant some trees this spring.

→ My grandfather is going

Question 44. Let's go to a pagoda and watch fireworks on New Year's Eve.

→ Why don't we ?

Question 45. My family usually has a gathering on Tet holiday.

→ There is usually a family

MINI REVIEW - KIẾN THỨC CẦN NHỚ

Tóm tắt các từ vựng & ngữ pháp trọng tâm trong bài thi

Key Vocabulary (Từ Vựng Chính)

  • 🌸 peach blossom: hoa đào
  • 🧧 lucky money: tiền lì xì
  • 🛋️ wooden furniture: đồ nội thất gỗ
  • 🤝 behave well: cư xử tốt / ngoan ngoãn

Key Grammar (Cấu Trúc Ngữ Pháp)

  • 1. Lời khuyên với Should / Shouldn't:

    S + should / shouldn't + V (nguyên thể)

    Ex: Children should behave well. / We shouldn't break things.
  • 2. Thì Hiện Tại Tiếp Diễn (Present Continuous):

    S + am/is/are + V-ing (dấu hiệu: Look!, right now, now)

    Ex: My mother is cooking banh chung right now.
